what: Draws a column of photo panels stacked seamlessly, alternating portrait and landscape, in WebGL, and spins it endlessly with wheel, drag and arrow keys. Wheel adds delta × .03 to velocity, damped by .97 per frame (.92 on phones). .5s after release (1s after drag), the panel nearest the 25% screen spot in the travel direction snaps to center over .8s power2.out. The image inside each panel shifts up and down the farther it is from center (distance relative to screen width × .6). At first the panels overlap at center as 8px dots, spread from .5s into a single line at 32px spacing (1.75s), fade from black into the picture (2s), and from 2s over 2.5s stand up into the full-size column (power3.inOut). Side list names change opacity .15–.95 by circular distance from the center panel (1s power3.out), and clicking a name goes to that panel. Pressing the landscape button restacks the panels into a double-size horizontal strip over 1.5s, starting with those farthest from center at .06s steps
ease: power3.inOut (first · change) · power2.out (attach) · 0.215,0.61,0.355,1 (jump by pressing a name)

options.snap-delay: Seconds after the wheel stops until it snaps into place, default .5
options.drag-delay: Seconds from drag release until it snaps in, default 1
options.parallax: Vertical shift of the image in the panel (multiple of screen width as distance), default .6 — 0 means none
options.parallax-x: Horizontal drift for horizontal bands, default .4
options.zoom: Share of the image shown inside the panel (smaller zooms in), default .8
options.ref: Center index where the first item sits, default 5
options.intro: dots (from dots to a column) · fade (the in-place column appears over 2s while pulling back .7→.8 — when re-entering with the art already loaded in the original) · none (column right away) · auto (dots if first in this document, fade when re-entering after the page is swapped — together with vt-swap-page)
options.wait: Wait (s) before the loader fills, default 1.2 — when a loader is present
options.fill: Seconds for the loading bar to fill, default .3
options.label: When the cursor reaches the center panel, the text sent via fx:crosshair, default OPEN PROJECT — changed per panel with data-crosshair
options.pick-ease: Curve when moving by clicking a name, default 0.215,0.61,0.355,1 — duration is distance ÷ 450 within 1~1.5s
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One panel (hidden) — data-format=portrait|landscape · data-label (placeholder text) · data-tone=dark|mid (dark·mid-tone photo slot) · data-href (pressing the center panel navigates) · inside If available, that illustration
options.[data-fx-part=names]·[data-fx-part=name]: (optional) the side list and its names — in the same order as the items
options.[data-fx-part=vertical]·[data-fx-part=ho: (Optional) Button to switch between vertical columns·horizontal bands
options.[data-fx-part=loader]: (optional) 8px loading cell in the center — one fill element inside
options.[data-fx-part=after]: (optional) a target that appears over 2s at 5s once everything is lined up (center crosshair)
options.Event: fx:pillar-gallery-gl { index, vertical } — When the center panel changes · fx:open { index, href } — When the center panel is pressed
